Then we visit the 15th item, the 23 (Visit 2)
Then we visit the 18th item, the 45. (Visit 3)
Then we visit the 19th item, another 45. (Visit 4)
Then we find the 56 at position 20. (Visit 5)
20 + 5 = 25
